posts.title: Tactile Sensory Board Rainbow and Sun Macarons
posts.description: My niece wanted some macarons for her classmates as she graduates from preschool. This was what I came up with.... ... based on her drawing below! She requested for vanilla but I added a strawberry component as well to balance out the sweetness even though I did try my best to make the vanilla ganache less sweet. Vanilla is actually a tricky flavour to do well for macarons because you have to be creative to find ways to reduce the overall sweetness of the confection. I filled each macaron with a ring of vanilla bean ganache and strawberry ganache in the middle. Both are dairy-free and temperature stable enough for gifting in tropical Singapore The macarons may look like there's nothing unique about them, right up to the point when you touch them. Squishy marshmallow clouds and bumpy surfaces on the rainbow and sun! Watch the reel to see the sensory board in action! https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgJMYPwSCWW/?dmpr=cnpjY3B1bjZkY3Uy You may find the recipe and method for the macaron shell

posts.title: Apple Cinnamon Black Tea Cake With Poached Apples
posts.description: This is the cake that my chiffon cake apples went on top of! I kept the base cake simple instead of the basket weave I made years ago over here as I wanted the chiffon apples to stand out. I filled the cake with poached apples instead of apple black tea jelly. A peek at the cake before putting the chiffon apples on top. Please see my reel below for the full recipe and assembly process. Method is pinned in the comments of the reel. I will share the ingredient list here https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfyBOLHygyZ/?avpt=ZTQ3dmg1ZDllODM5 Apple Black Tea Chiffon Sponge: (makes two thick 6" round sponges) 60g apple spiced black tea* 40g oil 1/8 tsp salt 72g cake flour 2g black tea powder 1/4 tsp cinnamon powder 1 tsp vanilla extract 4 large eggs, separated 1/4 tsp cream of tartar 65g caster sugar Apple Black Tea Diplomat Cream: 2 egg yolks 20g cornstarch 6g black tea powder 10g milk Pinch of salt 30g sugar 180g apple spiced black tea* 60g heavy cream 20g unsalted butter, softened 160g whippin

posts.title: Easy Matcha Nutella Succulent Tarts
posts.description: I challenged myself to come up with an activity for team bonding that doesn't need an oven, stove, fridge, freezer or electric mixer. This was what I came up with --- Matcha Nutella succulent tarts! A closer look at the cross section... This is an activity for the reading club volunteers where they teach young children from underprivileged families how to read. The succulent tarts may looks difficult to make but it's made simple by using premade tart shells and instant custard powder. You may make the tart shells and pastry cream from scratch (especially the pastry cream as it tastes better that way!) if you wish. But I was prioritizing quick and easy over taste 🤭. Composition: - store-bought sweet tart shells - Nutella - Lotte's sugar-free crunchy chocolate balls - matcha and red dragonfruit instant custard - toasted chopped hazelnuts or almonds You may watch this reel for how I put the tarts together: https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfYROIzS2L0/?exln=N2cyNHFycW9zbmd6 with love, Phay S
